purpose: Teach: たちまち/因みに/御覧/益々/まわる/向う/ちび/ちょいと

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが帰ってこられるとたちまち賑やかになるのよ
lines.en: Sho, it's amazing how lively things become the moment your father comes home.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle nostalgic smile in the voice. Soft pace, like watching something unfold. A note of tender affection beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、因みにぼく、絵が上手くなったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, by the way — I've gotten really good at drawing!
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery with genuine pride. Quick opening, slight breathlessness on the announcement. Looking for her approval, seeking validation from someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵を「御覧」になってね
lines.en: Sho, show me your drawings, won't you?
lines.style: Pleased and encouraging. Warm invitation in the tone. Slight lean toward him in the voice — genuine interest, not performing attention. The ease of someone who wants to see.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが益々お忙しいんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's been getting busier and busier lately, hasn't he?
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost thinking out loud. Hesitant delivery — noticing something without complaint. Small, perceptive child catching what adults sometimes miss.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ブランコをまわるみたいに揺らすと危ないわよ
lines.en: Sho, swinging it around like that is dangerous, you know.
lines.style: Gentle but firm correction. Warm maternal tone beneath the warning. No sharpness — protective, not scolding. A quiet steadiness that makes him listen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、向うの公園まで走ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ran all the way to the other park!
lines.style: Breathless excitement on the opening. Proud announcement of accomplishment. Quick pace, eager and alive. Seeking her amazement and approval.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ちびっ子の頃の写真、可愛いわね
lines.en: Sho, you were so cute in those photos from when you were little.
lines.style: Tender, almost wistful tone. Soft pace, genuine affection. The kind of voice that makes him pause — noticing something about himself he hadn't heard before.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ちょいとお手洗いに行ってくるね
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to the bathroom real quick, okay?
lines.style: Casual, light delivery. Quick beat — he's checking in before leaving, small consideration. Ordinary boyish tone, no drama. The ease of asking permission he knows will be given.
